meaning: A clogged filter (Waterwall models) or heater over-temperature (Rotary models), depending on model.
A drain-pump operation fault was detected.
fix_steps: 1. Reset then service: Turn the dishwasher off and start the cycle again; if the pump fault persists, contact support for service.

meaning: Incoming water is hotter than the allowed limit.
The water supply is inadequate in pressure or temperature.
fix_steps: 1. Restore the water supply: Confirm the supply valve is open and the inlet hose is unkinked with adequate pressure and temperature.

meaning: The dishwasher cannot drain.
fix_steps: 1. Clear the drain: Clear the filter and drain hose of any blockage, then restart the cycle. | 2. Replace the drain pump: If the filter and hose are clear and the drain error returns, disconnect power and water and replace the drain pump assembly.

meaning: The Waterwall reflector is not moving correctly.
The water level inside the tub is too low.
fix_steps: 1. Rerun and reset: Empty the unit, add detergent, and run a normal cycle; if it continues, power off at the breaker and request service.

meaning: A panel button is being sensed as stuck.
fix_steps: 1. Free the stuck button: Turn the dishwasher off and press each panel button once; if a button stays stuck or the error returns, contact support.

meaning: A communication fault occurred in the control electronics.
The water overheated beyond the safe limit.
fix_steps: 1. Reset at the breaker: Switch power off for thirty seconds at the breaker and back on, empty the unit, add detergent, and run a Normal cycle.

meaning: The heater temperature-detection circuit is faulty.
fix_steps: 1. Rerun and reset: Empty the unit, add detergent and run a normal cycle; if it persists, power off at the breaker and contact support.

meaning: The leak sensor detected moisture.
fix_steps: 1. Investigate the leak: The unit will keep draining until dry; check for a blocked Waterwall reflector on those models and inspect for leaks before restarting.

meaning: The water level is above the allowed maximum.
The temperature sensor is reading incorrectly.
A drive-motor fault was detected.
fix_steps: 1. Reset then service: Power off for two to three minutes and restart; if the motor error returns, request service.

meaning: The voltage supplied to the dryer is abnormal.
fix_steps: 1. Fix the power supply: Run the dryer on its own circuit without an extension cord and confirm correct cord installation and voltage; contact support if it persists.

meaning: Internal control modules cannot communicate with each other.
fix_steps: 1. Power-cycle the dryer: Shut the dryer off for sixty seconds and turn it back on; contact support if the communication error remains.

meaning: A control-panel button is being sensed as stuck.
fix_steps: 1. Free the stuck button: Power off and individually touch and release every button on the panel, working across each button's edges.

meaning: The exhaust vent is roughly eighty percent blocked.
fix_steps: 1. Clean filter and vent: Clean the lint filter and the exhaust vent, then rerun the cycle.

meaning: The exhaust vent is more than ninety percent blocked.
fix_steps: 1. Clean filter and vent: Clean the lint filter and the exhaust vent thoroughly — the vent is more than ninety percent blocked — then rerun the cycle.

meaning: The exhaust vent is clogged.
fix_steps: 1. Clean filter and vent: Clean the lint filter and the exhaust vent, then rerun the cycle.

meaning: The ambient temperature is outside the operating range.
fix_steps: 1. Let the dryer acclimate: Wait about an hour with the dryer at room temperature before restarting.

meaning: A fault was detected with the door, latch, or door sensor.
fix_steps: 1. Secure the door: Check the latch is intact, remove anything caught in the door, and close it until it latches fully.

meaning: The power-source frequency is invalid.
fix_steps: 1. Restart the cycle: Restart the cycle; if the frequency error remains, contact support.

meaning: The dryer is overheating.
fix_steps: 1. Clean lint and check voltage: Clean the lint screen and vent system; on electric models have an electrician confirm the supply voltage if overheating persists. | 2. Replace the heating element: If airflow is clear and overheating returns, disconnect power and replace the heating element.

meaning: A gas-ignition fault was detected on gas models.
fix_steps: 1. Reset then service: Power off for two to three minutes and restart; if the gas-ignition error returns, request service.

meaning: The load did not dry within the expected time.
fix_steps: 1. Reset and retry: Power off for two to three minutes and restart the cycle; consult the manual and request service if it returns.

meaning: The temperature-sensing circuit reported a fault.
fix_steps: 1. Clean the lint screen and vent: Clean the lint screen, the vent system, or both — trapped heat is the most common cause; contact support if the error continues.

meaning: The freezer fan is not rotating as sensed by the control.
fix_steps: 1. Defrost or request service: Ensure the freezer is not overpacked and the door gaskets seal fully; defrost the unit if you wish, otherwise request service.

meaning: The fridge fan is faulty, sometimes following a door left open.
fix_steps: 1. Defrost the fridge fan: Unplug the refrigerator and leave the doors open for a few hours, then plug it back in; request service if the error returns.

meaning: The ice-pipe heater reported a fault.
fix_steps: 1. Request professional service: Samsung directs this ice-pipe heater fault to service; contact the Support Center.

meaning: The ice-maker function reported a fault.
fix_steps: 1. Request professional service: Samsung directs this ice-maker function fault to service; contact the Support Center.

meaning: The ice-room fan reported a fault.
fix_steps: 1. Request professional service: Samsung directs this ice-room fan fault to service; contact the Support Center.

meaning: The fridge defrost sensor reported a fault.
fix_steps: 1. Request professional service: Samsung directs this defrost-sensor fault to service; contact the Support Center.

meaning: Water was detected in the autofill compartment.
fix_steps: 1. Inspect the autofill pitcher: Follow the autofill leak guidance: remove and inspect the autofill compartment for water and dry it out.

meaning: The compressor drew abnormal current.
fix_steps: 1. Power-cycle at the breaker: Unplug or switch off the breaker for sixty seconds, then restore power; request service if the code returns.

meaning: The compressor is locked.
fix_steps: 1. Request professional service: Samsung directs the compressor-lock fault to service; contact the Support Center.

meaning: Low voltage was detected at the power source.
fix_steps: 1. Clear the voltage notice: Press OK for three seconds to clear; the code is harmless and typically follows a brief outage.

meaning: The compressor experienced an undervoltage (brown-out) condition.
fix_steps: 1. Power-cycle at the breaker: Unplug or switch off the breaker for sixty seconds, then restore power; request service if the code returns.

meaning: The compressor experienced an overvoltage (surge) condition.
fix_steps: 1. Power-cycle at the breaker: Unplug or switch off the breaker for sixty seconds, then restore power; request service if the code returns.

meaning: The freezer ice-maker sensor reported a fault.
fix_steps: 1. Request professional service: Samsung directs this ice-maker sensor fault to service; contact the Support Center.

meaning: A communication fault occurred between internal components.
fix_steps: 1. Reseat the door harness: Unplug the unit, disconnect and reconnect the wire harness above the door, then restore power; request service if the error returns.

meaning: A low water level was detected during operation.
fix_steps: 1. Check hose and leaks: Verify the drain hose position and inspect for leaks.

meaning: A control-panel button fault was detected.
fix_steps: 1. Clean the buttons: Clean the control buttons with a dampened cloth.

meaning: A signal communication fault was detected.
fix_steps: 1. Power-cycle and wait: Wait briefly or power-cycle, then restart the programme.

meaning: The water-level sensor reported a fault.
fix_steps: 1. Power-cycle the washer: Switch off for one minute, then restart the programme.

meaning: The water-level sensor or leak detection reported a fault.
fix_steps: 1. Check for leaks and suds: Inspect hoses for kinks and leaks and run an empty cycle to confirm no excess suds are present.

meaning: A drive-motor fault was detected.
fix_steps: 1. Power-cycle the washer: Switch off for one minute, then restart the programme; request service if the motor fault returns.

meaning: A drive-motor fault was detected.
fix_steps: 1. Reset then service: Power off for two to three minutes and restart; if the motor fault returns, request service.

meaning: An electronic control fault was detected.
fix_steps: 1. Restart the cycle: Restart the cycle; request service if the control fault returns.

meaning: The washer is not receiving water correctly during fill.
fix_steps: 1. Restore the water supply: Open the tap fully, confirm supply pressure is within 0.5 to 8 bar, clean the mesh filter, and check the hose for kinks.

meaning: The washer is not receiving water correctly during fill.
fix_steps: 1. Restore the water supply: Confirm the hoses are connected without kinks, open the supply valves fully, seat the drain hose correctly, and power-cycle for one minute.

meaning: The incoming water is running hot, indicating a hot-tap connection.
fix_steps: 1. Connect to the cold supply: Ensure the inlet hose is connected to the cold (blue) tap, not the hot supply.

meaning: The cold supply line is running unexpectedly hot, indicating reversed hoses.
The washer cannot drain the water away.
fix_steps: 1. Clear the drain: Empty via the emergency drain hose, clean the pump filter, and check the drain hose for blockages or kinks.

meaning: Water is not leaving the tub at the expected rate, or at all.
fix_steps: 1. Clear the drain path: Check the drain hose and drain filter for clogs or kinks, clear them, then restart the cycle. | 2. Replace the drain pump: If the drain path is clear and the code returns, disconnect power and water, open the lower access panel, and replace the drain pump (the component Samsung attributes to this code).

meaning: The water heater is malfunctioning.
fix_steps: 1. Request professional service: Samsung directs water-heater faults to the Service Centre.

meaning: The vibration (MEMS) sensor reported a fault.
fix_steps: 1. Power-cycle the washer: Power off and restart the cycle.

meaning: The vibration (MEMS) sensor reported a fault.
Low supply voltage was detected.
fix_steps: 1. Check the power supply: Verify the power supply and plug connection deliver stable voltage.

meaning: An irregularity was detected in the supply voltage.
A communication fault occurred between electronic modules.
The washer is running a calibration cycle.
fix_steps: 1. Let calibration finish: Verify the cold water supply and allow the calibration cycle to complete.

meaning: The door is not fully closed or something is trapped in it.
fix_steps: 1. Secure the door: Ensure the door is fully closed with nothing trapped in it.

meaning: The door is not closed and locked.
fix_steps: 1. Secure the door: Confirm the latch is intact, clear anything caught in the door, and close it firmly until it locks. | 2. Replace the door lock: If the latch is intact and the door still reads open, disconnect power and replace the door lock switch assembly.

meaning: The AddWash door was opened without pausing the cycle.
fix_steps: 1. Close and resume: Close the AddWash door and press Start/Pause to resume.

meaning: The on/off switch reported a fault.
fix_steps: 1. Rest and retry: Power off, wait five minutes, and try again.

meaning: An overflow condition was detected, often from excess detergent.
fix_steps: 1. Reduce detergent and reset: Use less detergent, then power-cycle and restart.

meaning: An unbalanced load was detected.
fix_steps: 1. Rebalance the load: Redistribute the laundry, or add items to balance a small load.

meaning: A motor fault was detected.
fix_steps: 1. Power-cycle the washer: Switch off for one minute, then restart the programme.

meaning: The temperature sensor is reading incorrectly.
fix_steps: 1. Power-cycle the washer: Switch off for one minute, then restart the programme.

meaning: A fan fault was detected on washer-dryer models.
fix_steps: 1. Request professional service: Samsung directs fan faults to the Service Centre.

meaning: The heating circuit is out of range.
fix_steps: 1. Basic reset: Power off for two to three minutes, power on, and restart the cycle; contact support if it persists.

meaning: The dryer heater overheated and shut down for safety.
fix_steps: 1. Request professional service: The dryer heater shut down for safety; contact the Service Centre.

meaning: The steam function is malfunctioning.
fix_steps: 1. Request professional service: Samsung directs steam-function faults to the Service Centre.

meaning: The appliance is hot and the fan is running until it cools.
fix_steps: 1. Let it cool: Not a fault: the fan runs until the appliance cools to about 55 degrees Celsius.

meaning: The water level rose above the permitted maximum.
fix_steps: 1. Address the overflow: Follow the drainage checks to remove excess water and inspect for a stuck water valve or level sensor.

meaning: A clutch-position fault was detected.
A power fault was detected at the socket or fuse.
fix_steps: 1. Check socket and fuse: Power-cycle, check the socket, and replace the plug fuse if needed.

meaning: The detergent drawer is not fully closed.
Excess suds were detected and the cycle paused to clear the foam.
fix_steps: 1. Clear the suds: Run an empty cycle with no additives until the suds clear, then reduce detergent going forward.

meaning: A temperature-sensor fault was detected.
The load is unbalanced and the drum cannot spin safely.
fix_steps: 1. Rebalance the load: Untangle and redistribute the laundry evenly in the tub, close the door, and restart.

meaning: Voltage fluctuation was detected in the supply.
fix_steps: 1. Stabilize the supply: Connect directly to a wall socket without extension cables and verify the supply.
